samples.question: The picture shows one empty grid of 7 rows and 7 columns of square cells, and above the grid a list of solid triangular arrows. Exactly one cell of the grid carries a small hollow square marker: that cell is where the pen starts. Read the arrows in printed order, taking the top row of arrows first, then each next row down, and inside a row from left to right. Each arrow moves the pen exactly one cell in the direction that arrow points: up, down, left or right. Ink the starting cell and every cell the pen enters; a cell entered more than once is simply inked. The pen never leaves the grid. The inked cells form a shape that most closely matches one of these five symbols: bracket (two horizontal bars, one along the top row and one lower down, joined at their right ends by a short vertical bar), ell (a vertical bar down the left column with a horizontal foot running right along the bottom row), plus (a horizontal bar across the middle row crossing a vertical bar down the middle column), stairs (a staircase of cells climbing from the bottom left corner to the top right corner), tee (a bar along the top row with a vertical stem hanging from its middle). Which symbol is it? Answer with one word.
